results.title: Fresh low pressure to drench Odisha, multiple warnings issued for several districts
results.description: A fresh low pressure system is expected to affect Odisha , with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasting heavy rainfall across the state over the next four days. The Regional Meteorological Centre in Bhubaneswar has issued an Orange warning for very heavy rainfall in four districts. The affected areas are Keonjhar, Angul , Dhenkanal, and Cuttack . Yellow Warning A yellow warning for heavy rainfall has also been issued for 16 districts. These include Puri, Khordha, Nayagarh, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara , Jajpur, Bhadrak, Balasore, Mayurbhanj, Sundargarh, Jharsuguda , Deogarh, Sambalpur, Bargarh , Sonepur, and Boudh. The weather department has further forecasted wind speeds of 30 to 40 kmph across these districts. Fishermen Advised Meanwhile, due to rough sea conditions die to prevailing weather pattern, fishermen have been advised not to venture into the sea until July 27. Monsoon Surplus Offset June Deficit This upcoming rainfall builds on a strong monsoon recovery in July following a dry June. Between June 1 and July 23, Odisha recorded an average of 536.7 mm of rain against the normal average of 458.8 mm, creating a 17 per cent seasonal surplus.
